title: The Great Stink: The River That Drove Out Parliament
summary: Tells how, in the hot summer of eighteen fifty-eight, the stench of a Thames filled with sewage forced the British Parliament to soak its curtains in chloride of lime and flee. The episode covers the law passed in eighteen days once the stink arrived, the sewer network built by Joseph Bazalgette, and how this system saved London from cholera even though it was built on a wrong theory.
